title: dinostomp run manifest
description: Sidecar written next to every run file. Records everything needed to reproduce, price, and audit the run without opening the run file.

tool_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the engine that produced this run: its own code and schema pack. Everything else influencing a run is hashed into the manifest, and the engine influences every run, so it is hashed too. Recompute with `dinostomp fingerprint`.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact spec file that produced this run. Drift between spec and results is detectable forever.

data_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact data file that produced this run. Required: unhashed inputs are outside the drift boundary and therefore forbidden.

scorer_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the custom scorer code file, present whenever scorer kind is python.

judge_sha256.description: SHA-256 of a pod-local judge entrypoint, present whenever the scorer is a python judge. A judge is an input: editing it after a run is drift.

judge_calls.description: How many times the judge was called during this run. A judge is not free just because it is not the examinee.

mount_sha256.description: {declared path: sha256} for files this pod depends on from OUTSIDE itself. Declaring a mount is what makes referencing it legal; hashing it is what the declaration buys.

target_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the target entrypoint file, present whenever this run used a python target. The agent is an input like any other: editing it after a run is drift.

spend_source.description: Where spend_usd came from. `metered` prices provider-returned tokens against the rate table. `target_reported` means the target priced its own calls: the ledger records the claim and cannot audit it, which the report states rather than implying the number is metered.

witness_report.description: Outcome of running the scorer's witness cases before real data. A run whose witnesses failed carries that mark permanently.

env.description: Environment fingerprint: python version, platform, package versions. Requests are reproducible given this envelope; hosted-model immutability stays UNKNOWN.

probe.description: Present when this run is a probe, not a result. Blind probes strip every input before the call (read only by R13). Judge probes grade constructed cases whose right verdict is known by construction (read only by J1/J2). Neither ever pools with real runs.

model_reported.description: The model identifier the provider actually returned, verbatim. Hosted aliases move; this records what really answered.

git.description: State of the eval directory's repo at run time, when one exists.

status.description: Run lifecycle state. Load-bearing: C1 and the psychometric checks only trust records from a `complete` run.

run_file.description: Relative path of the JSONL run file this manifest describes.

isolation.description: How a mediated agent was run for this run.

trajectory_source.description: Who wrote the trajectory: the target itself, or the harness that held its tools. T8 reports it.

tool_sha256_by_name.description: SHA-256 of each pod-local tool the harness offered.
